acceptance_tests: The approved proposal SHA-256 remains exact and this bundle passes the Sonic Research Lab structure and readiness validators.
The portable Core performs no processing-path allocation, accepts at most 128 events per block, contains non-finite state, and never emits a sample whose absolute value exceeds 0.8912.

Accepted events are ordered by (sample_index, ingress_sequence), applied before the named sample, and produce byte-identical event ledgers and WAVs for block partitions 1, 16, 64, 257, and 512 plus a fresh repeated block-64 run.
CUT uses the frozen nine-zone table, hysteresis, beat-boundary commit, fixed-denominator cut distribution, swing bounds, and deterministic Downbeat behavior.
Reset, Panic, VOID, OPEN, FLIP, ratio changes, event overflow, and non-finite recovery match state-matrix.md and normalized Reset replay equality.
The frozen 63-tap coefficient bytes authenticate and the 4x Wire output meets the 8x reference residual and alias thresholds in experiment.json.
WF01 fundamental, spectral-centroid, RMS-compensation, peak, and DC observations meet the frozen tolerances.
WF02 produces true interior silence after the clamped edge; WF03 produces the required low-band occupation and Wire-band suppression with exact schedule parity.
CMP01_SQUARE and CMP02_PARALLEL_LOW are rendered from the literal frozen fixtures and remain capable of falsifying the scheduler and complementary-voice hypotheses.
Instrument Lab repository and Wirefall consumer checks pass without modifying Cinderwheel, Tide Pit, canonical Schuss records, providers, runtimes, targets, or backends.
